notes: Very close pair. Both keep the four-column day view, add a waiting-room list with wait times, show the double booking and put alerts first. B answers the 'colour means type' complaint better: colour shows only status and types are written as words. A still uses type colour bars and a legend, but adds clear status badges. Neither groups the 14 tabs much. The legacy screen covers the content but its structure fails the front-desk quotes.
